claims.says: The modelled plan_query stitching loop builds exactly the nested fill of the clause plans, each earlier clause's plan inserted at the insertion point of the plan after it.
If the last clause plan and every middle clause plan implement their clause at their insertion point, the stitched query plan evaluates to the composition of the clause meanings.
Given that DISTINCT over an aggregate changes nothing, the WITH/RETURN plan (projection or aggregation, DISTINCT, ORDER BY, SKIP, LIMIT, WHERE) computes its clause's meaning on any input plan.
If non-pattern atoms are never null, the SemiApply/AntiSemiApply/OrApplyMultiplexer/Filter tree built for a supported WHERE keeps exactly the input rows where the predicate is true.
